title: Number Bases: Conversion and Operations
seo_title: Number Bases – JSS 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Convert numbers between base ten and other bases and from one base to another; add, subtract and multiply numbers in bases other than ten. (summary of the NERDC JSS 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 2 maths worksheets on number bases: converting between bases, adding, subtracting and multiplying in bases two to eight, and finding an unknown base. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Check every base sum in base ten
key_sub: In base b, carry or borrow b.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • In base b the place values are 1, b, b², b³, … and the digits go from 0 to b − 1.
  • To change from one base to another, change to base ten first.
  • To add in base b, carry 1 each time a column reaches b. To subtract, borrow b, not 10.

Examples

Example

243₅ + 134₅

3 + 4 = 7 = 12₅: write 2, carry 1

4 + 3 + 1 = 8 = 13₅

2 + 1 + 1 = 4

Answer: 432₅

Example

23 in base b = 17

2b + 3 = 17

Answer: b = 7

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Carrying 10Carry when a column reaches the base.
Using a digit equal to the baseBase 6 has digits 0 to 5 only.
Converting directly between two basesGo through base ten.
